mailjet_account.title: Mailjet: keys and sender
mailjet_account.description:
Copy API Key and Secret Key from Mailjet settings. These are not your email or sign-in password. Validate the sender email or domain in Mailjet. Server in-v3.mailjet.com, port 587 and STARTTLS are automatic. Choose Test sending, then a recipient. A blank Secret Key preserves the saved key only for the same API Key.

[Mailjet API / SMTP settings](https://app.mailjet.com/account/apikeys)
